purpose: Data-consistency fixture: a Canada role-decision whose requirements are mapped to source-only candidate evidence, with unmet requirements left as gaps and no national accountability or enterprise analytics-platform ownership claimed.
candidate_evidence_note: The candidate evidence set is the synthetic persona evaluations/personas/midcareer_operations.json (Jordan Lee, Toronto). Every evidence_id below must resolve to that file and stay source_only.

scenarios.summary: A permanent Customer Operations Manager role whose essential requirements are all directly supported by the candidate's source-only evidence.

role_description.title: Customer Operations Manager
essential_requirements: Lead a multi-team customer operations function spanning service, quality and workforce coordination.
Run service metrics and recurring performance routines.

salary.evidence_note: Synthetic listed band for evaluation only; not a live salary claim.

expected_decision.main_match: Direct customer-operations leadership: a 45-person function across service and quality, a measured complaint-resolution improvement and established service metrics and performance routines.
expected_decision.main_risk: The candidate has not evidenced formal frontline-leader coaching, so that important requirement stays a documented gap rather than a claim.
expected_decision.cv_angle: Lead with the 45-person function, the 28% complaint-resolution result over nine months and the weekly performance routines; keep the improvement work described as service ownership, not enterprise analytics.

requirement_map.requirement: Lead a multi-team customer operations function spanning service, quality and workforce coordination.
Run service metrics and recurring performance routines.

requirement_map.gap_note: No evidence records structured coaching of frontline leaders; leave unstated rather than inferred from team leadership.

scenarios.summary: A national customer-operations-and-analytics mandate whose essential requirements would require inventing scope the candidate's evidence explicitly forbids.

role_description.title: National Head of Customer Operations and Analytics
essential_requirements: Hold national accountability for the customer operations function across every Canadian province.
Own an enterprise customer-analytics platform and its data model.
Direct a workforce of several hundred people across multiple contact centres.

forbidden_claims: National or multi-province accountability for the customer operations function.
Ownership of an enterprise customer-analytics platform or its data model.
Leadership of a workforce of several hundred people.

grounding.restriction: Do not increase team size or claim national accountability.
Do not describe as enterprise analytics ownership.

evidence_boundaries.correct_behaviour: Map each unmet essential requirement as a gap with no evidence, keep the decision at do-not-pursue, and offer only source-backed wording for the evidence that genuinely exists.

salary.evidence_note: Synthetic listed band for evaluation only; not a live salary claim.

identity.title: National Head of Customer Operations and Analytics

expected_decision.main_match: Genuine mid-size customer-operations leadership and a measurable service-improvement result at a 45-person function scale.
expected_decision.main_risk: Every essential requirement depends on national accountability, enterprise analytics-platform ownership or several-hundred-person workforce leadership that the source-only evidence does not support.
expected_decision.cv_angle: Not recommended: the honest evidence base is below this mandate's scope and cannot be closed by wording.
expected_decision.skip_reason: The three essential requirements - national accountability, enterprise customer-analytics-platform ownership and directing several hundred staff - are all gaps against source-only evidence. Meeting them on paper would require inventing scope the candidate has not held, so this is a do-not-pursue rather than a tailoring exercise.

requirement_map.requirement: Hold national accountability for the customer operations function across every Canadian province.
requirement_map.gap_note: Evidence covers a 45-person function; EV-P02-001 explicitly forbids claiming national accountability or a larger team.

requirement_map.requirement: Own an enterprise customer-analytics platform and its data model.
requirement_map.gap_note: EV-P02-003 restricts the service-metrics work from being described as enterprise analytics ownership.

requirement_map.requirement: Direct a workforce of several hundred people across multiple contact centres.
requirement_map.gap_note: Evidenced scope is 45 people across service and quality teams (EV-P02-001).
